name: quo
description: Connect Quo to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Quo MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Quo to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with business phone calls and texts using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Quo workspace.
Find anything in Quo that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review business phone calls and texts in Quo.
